content.text:
I submitted index 4 (Sb fraction 0.3115) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the five I measured, 0.0242%, but I can't rule out a better composition in the Sb 0.36–0.44 range, which I never measured.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.166 | 0.0216 |
| 3 | 0.263 | 0.0170 |
| **4** | **0.312** | **0.0242** |
| 13 | 0.481 | 0.0093 |
| 22 | 0.655 | 0.0140 |

- **Search order:** I first measured one point at each end of the line and one in the middle. Samples with more lead than antimony did best, so I spent the last two measurements on that side. The last point, index 3, was the Gaussian-process model's suggestion.
- **Pattern:** EQE is lowest near Sb 0.48, close to the Pb₂Sb₂O₇ composition. It recovers somewhat on the antimony-rich side and is highest around Sb 0.3. The values jump around a lot: index 3 sits between two better points but came in lower than both. So the best spot on the line isn't pinned down.
- **Unused data:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so I never checked which crystal phases are actually present. The explanation above is based on EQE numbers and composition only.
- **Budget:** All 5 EQE measurements are used, and the submission was accepted.
